yt_2_pika_palace.blurb: Pika Palace is a roadside sport crag on Mount White, among the Roadside Crags east of Whitehorse. Ten bolted routes work their way up a detached flake of limestone, with a spread from 5.8 into the low 5.12s and the bulk of the climbing at 5.11. The wall is sunny, and the crag sits right beside 3 Bolt Wonderland, so the two are easily combined in a day. Mixed in with the harder lines are a few 5.9 routes that suit climbers warming up or stepping up to sport.

yt_orange_corner.blurb: Orange Corner is a compact wall on Paint Mountain (Tsi Dhal) above Pine Lake near Haines Junction. Ten routes, six sport and four trad, run from about 5.7 up to 5.12, with a cluster of 5.11s and a handful of easier lines in the 5.7 to 5.9 range. The wall catches the sun for most of the day, and the walk-up is short. From the wall, climbers look across the lake toward the St Elias Mountains' Front Ranges. Paint Mountain's rock is fractured in places, so expect some loose spots.

wy_the_marxism_wall.blurb: The Marxism Wall is a sport crag in Sinks Canyon near Lander, on Fairfield Hill within the Fairfield East area. All ten routes are bolted, running from 5.10 through 5.12, with most of them at 5.11. The lines here are longer and more technical than the ones further right along the hill. Fairfield East overall is mostly vertical to slightly off-vertical, and the climbing rewards crimps, flakes and textured holds, with a few bulges that steepen the routes.

az_geronimo_area.blurb: Geronimo Area is a stretch of the Leap in Queen Creek Canyon, near Superior, central Arizona. Of its ten routes, nine are sport and one is trad, covering a wide spread from easy terrain through 5.7 and 5.8 up to about 5.10, so beginners and intermediates both find something. Geronimo itself is a two-pitch 5.7, and Broken Arrow, Skyscraper and Puzzle Pieces are among the other routes here. The anchors sit on large west-facing blocks along the cliff edge.

ca_middle_earth_left.blurb: Middle Earth Left is the leftmost set of crags within Middle Earth in Mission Gorge, Mission Trails Regional Park, San Diego. It sits a little apart from the busier main formation. Ten short routes mix sport, top-rope and trad, ranging from about 5.7 to 5.12 with most at 5.10. Routes tend to be brief, with a tricky low section giving way to easier ground, and Fool's Gold is the first line you meet when approaching the wall.
